RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between Alderwood Properties LLC ("Landlord") and the undersigned Tenant for the property located at 42 Birchwood Lane, Unit 3B.

1. Term. This Agreement begins on the Commencement Date and continues for a period of twelve (12) months, after which it converts to a month-to-month tenancy unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the initial term.

2. Rent. Tenant shall pay Landlord monthly rent of $2,400.00, due on the first day of each calendar month. Rent not received within five (5) days of the due date is considered late.

3. Late Fees. A late fee equal to 8% of the monthly rent shall be charged for any payment received after the five (5) day grace period, and an additional $25.00 per day shall accrue for each day the payment remains outstanding thereafter.

4. Security Deposit. Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $2,400.00 prior to occupancy. Landlord may retain all or part of the deposit to cover unpaid rent, damages beyond normal wear and tear, or cleaning costs, and shall return any remaining balance within twenty-one (21) days of move-out.

5. Termination by Landlord. Landlord may terminate this Agreement immediately and without prior notice if Tenant fails to pay rent when due, causes significant damage to the premises, or engages in illegal activity on the property.

5.1. Upon termination under Section 5, Tenant forfeits any right to the security deposit beyond documented damages and remains liable for rent through the end of the original term.

5.2. Landlord's right to terminate under this Section may be exercised at Landlord's sole discretion and is not subject to cure period, notwithstanding any other provision of this Agreement.

6. Maintenance and Repairs. Tenant shall promptly notify Landlord of any needed repairs. Landlord shall make necessary repairs within a reasonable time, except that repairs required due to Tenant's negligence shall be Tenant's financial responsibility.

7. Right of Entry. Landlord may enter the premises with twenty-four (24) hours' notice for inspections, repairs, or showings, or without notice in the event of an emergency.

8. Subletting. Tenant may not sublet the premises or assign this Agreement without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

9. Liability. Landlord shall not be liable for any loss, injury, or damage to Tenant's personal property arising from any cause whatsoever, including but not limited to fire, theft, water damage, or acts of other tenants, regardless of Landlord's negligence.

10. Renewal and Rent Increase. At the end of the initial term, Landlord may increase rent by up to 10% with sixty (60) days' written notice. Tenant's continued occupancy after such notice constitutes acceptance of the new rent amount.

11. Pets. No pets are permitted on the premises without Landlord's prior written consent and payment of a non-refundable pet fee of $350.00 per animal.

12. Quiet Enjoyment. Tenant has the right to quiet enjoyment of the premises free from unreasonable disturbance by Landlord or other tenants.

13. Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the state in which the property is located.

14. Entire Agreement. This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, or agreements, whether written or oral.
